items.html: And it is found that since the drops of the coupling of the aforementioned AA are given into his Yesod, they stand exactly within the two Yesodot of AVI, and then the Yesod of AA, standing within them, poured and gave these drops into the Yesod of Aba. And they mixed there with the right half of ZON that clothes within Aba as mentioned. And then Aba, afterward, in the secret of coupling, when he coupled with Ima, gave that half together with those drops in the secret of coupling within Ima, and then all the discernment of ZON is found in the secret of gestation within Ima alone. And this will be explained well and at length.
